retrievalProfile.description: A framed realist painting of a child looking into a mirror, topped by a sharp geometric logo and wide-tracked serif subtitle.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central oil painting depicting a young girl seated before a floor mirror, framed by a thin orange border and set against a cream background. Above the frame sits a large, custom geometric logo with sharp angles and a smaller, widely spaced serif subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: The mirror reflection creates a dual-subject focal point within the frame.
The sharp, modern geometry of the top logo contrasts with the soft, painterly realism of the central image.
The cream outer margin provides a neutral breathing space for the dense central illustration.
The thin orange border acts as a bridge between the warm tones of the painting and the graphic elements.
coreInvariants: A large angular logo at the top center
A wide-tracked subtitle directly beneath the logo
Warm, earthy color palette with cream margins

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The painting occupies the central 70% of the vertical space, with the girl and her reflection centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The floor mirror frame and the girl's reflection serve as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the sharp geometric logo, move down to the subtitle, and then settle into the narrative detail of the painting.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial cream-colored margins surround the central framed artwork.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low-to-medium saturation with high value contrast in the painting to create depth.

letterConstructionRules: Logo: Sharp 45 and 90-degree angles, interlocking strokes, consistent line weight.
Subtitle: High-contrast serif with extremely wide tracking.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' and 'P' in the logo use diagonal strokes that mirror each other's angles.
The 'S' in the subtitle is a classic Roman serif.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Geometric architectural logo paired with a delicate, widely-spaced classical serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the geometric yet serif-influenced feel of the era.
Appropriate for the wide-tracked lowercase subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an oil painting in the style of Norman Rockwell featuring a young girl sitting on a stool looking into a large floor mirror. Surround the painting with a thin orange border and place it on a wide cream-colored background, leaving space at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large geometric, angular custom logo in white with orange outlines at the top center. Below it, add a lowercase serif subtitle in white with extremely wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the painting style realist and painterly?
Is the logo geometric and angular?
Is the subtitle tracking significantly wide?
Is there a clear cream margin around the central image?

mustRedesign: Specific character faces from the original painting
Any specific promotional stickers or text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the logo does not overlap the painting frame.
Verify the cream margin is consistent on all sides.
Confirm the subtitle is centered and legible despite wide tracking.
recipe.reuseFormula: Realist Illustration + Geometric Logo Header + Wide-Tracked Serif Subtitle + Framed Margin Layout
